svg.text: When each machine was taking work, 14 October to 6 November 2026, UTC
A sample every minute from Wed 14 Oct 19:10 to Fri 6 Nov 08:20 UTC. Braket: ONLINE and inside an execution window. IonQ: available. IBM: operational and active.
Braket says ONLINE for a machine that is between windows and will not run anything, so the light blue is as closed as the red.
